title: AE for Jones Main Gym Floor Replacement
short_description: Design services for replacing an existing athletic wood gym floor at UNC Pembroke.
project_scope: Replacement of the existing athletic wood flooring system in Jones Main Gym at the University of North Carolina at Pembroke. The project begins with a programming phase to confirm scope, cost, funding, and ADA compliance requirements. No gross floor area or further technical dimensions are stated.
services: Professional design services starting with programming; requested disciplines include interior design/space planning, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, and construction/project management.
relevance_explanation:
- Small refurbishment project focused on gym floor replacement.
- Limited structural complexity; no long-span roof, bridge, or special structural system described.
- Scope is primarily interior refurbishment and programming rather than demanding structural engineering.
- Sports facility context is generally of interest, but this specific task is too minor and non-structural for sbp's core profile.
construction_cost_explanation: Taken from the tender documents (Total Construction Cost: $750.0K).

references_qualifications: Qualified professional service firms are requested; specific reference counts or detailed qualification thresholds are not stated in the source.
